services.name: Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: The Sea-Doo GTX Pro offers an outstanding blend of performance and practicality. With 130hp it will reach speeds of 50-55mph and the wide hull design keeps participants dryer while riding in mild conditions. Limited to a 400lb load, this vessel can comfortably seat two within the weight limit. Rental skis are limited to a ride area in the Gulf of Mexico, 5 miles by 2 miles. Our jet ski riding area is 10 square miles, providing plenty of space to go fast and far. Each jet ski can carry up to 400 lbs., making this a perfect option for all ages and groups. Take the family out or gather a group of friends for an exciting adventure. Jet ski tours are our favorite way to explore the local waters.

services.name: Boat Charter
services.desc: Join Blind Pass Boat and Jet Ski Rental for the ultimate Sandbar Bash, a private boat adventure that’s all about fun, sun, and good vibes. Cruise with your licensed captain to one of St. Pete Beach’s most popular sandbars or hidden island spots where clear shallow waters, soft white sand, and island music set the perfect scene for a laid-back party on the water. Once anchored, the fun begins! Swim, float, shell hunt, or just relax in the sun with your favorite drinks and tunes on our Bluetooth sound system. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Take to the coastal waterways to truly experience the beauty of Florida. Cruise in and out of the intra-coastal and near-coastal waters with ease and style on a beautiful deck boat from Blind Pass Boat and Jet Ski Rental. Also check out our custom charter rides for a guided adventure! Our deck boats offer a great option for groups up to 6 people to explore the coastal and near coastal waters. Our deck boats are a combination of comfort and performance. Drafting 3′ of water and powered by a 150hp outboard motor, this is a great option for any day on the water.
